hero.headline: Discover The Living Architecture of the Plant Kingdom.
hero.subcopy: Explore authoritative botanical monographs spanning flowering ornamentals, tropical fruit trees, sacred medicinal herbs, canopy giants, and wetland flora—engineered with Linnaean taxonomy, morphology, ecology, and horticultural care.

about.heading: An Academic Reference Built for Curious Botanists and Growers
paragraphs: Plantipedia transforms botanical reference literature into a structured, high-contrast digital museum. Every entry in the archive pairs classical taxonomic rigor—from family lineage and floral morphology to pollination syndromes—with practical agronomic guidance rooted in South Asian, tropical, and global growing traditions.

Curated cleanly across 20 documented plant species, the archive delivers eight-chapter monographs backed by verified field photography and structured classification tables. Explore our top 3 flagship specimens below or open the complete A–Z botanical directory.
